name: cogentstack
description: Reuse one signed-in CogentStack browser workspace as a page-only 50/50 companion, retire only completed installation tabs, optionally use an isolated in-Codex panel, and execute approved project actions.

interface.shortDescription: Reuse one signed-in workspace and retire completed install tabs.
interface.longDescription: CogentStack reuses an existing CogentStack workspace or home tab and its normal Chrome or Edge session, navigates that same tab to the hosted workspace when needed, hides the desktop sidebar, places a clean white backdrop behind the workspace, and presents the web document itself as a reversible page-only right panel in an equal-width 50/50 split. It never repurposes a pending installation, account, or legal page. The website marks completed or superseded installation pages explicitly; the launcher may retire only those terminal tabs when a workspace already exists, or reuse one when no workspace or home tab exists. A 12-pixel white divider separates the panels. Browser controls are positioned outside the work area without using monitor-wide F11; the companion header X returns that same tab to the CogentStack home page, restores the normal browser frame, maximizes that ordinary browser window, restores the desktop window, and removes the backdrop. It reports login only when that selected page exposes its account control and never reads or copies cookies or credentials. Only when no workspace, home, or safely reusable terminal installation tab exists does it open the exact hosted URL once as a normal tab in the registered browser. An isolated native Codex panel remains available only when explicitly requested and uses the account-bound installation credential without repeating legal confirmation. Natural-language briefs become explicitly approved projects through verified server-generated artifacts, approved Deployment Packs can be prepared, and project-folder deletion runs only after exact hosted confirmation. Project Type Contracts, blueprints, compatibility rules, licence validation, and subscriber data remain on the protected CogentStack service.
